roles.emptyDescription: Create a role to group permissions and assign them to members.
roles.guardRailBody: The permissions below hide and disable actions inside VibeSSH, which stops somebody doing them by accident. They cannot stop somebody who does not want to be stopped: these operations run over each member's own SSH connection, from their own machine, so anyone who can reach the Node can do the same thing without VibeSSH at all. For a boundary that really holds, give the member a Node account with limited sudo.
